tagline: Keeps unattended agents from rewriting identity files or crossing aparta profile scopes silently.
limitations: v1 reviews apply, remove, init, add, doctor --fix, shell-install, fallback --secure/--restore, run --profile and --with-gh-token; read-only and --dry-run preview commands are never reviewed.
This listing is maintained by the aparta author and reflects aparta 0.9.x; new aparta commands need a rule update here.
